name: Chuk MNQ opening-range breakout

source.title: Regime-Dependent Opening Range Breakout Returns in Nasdaq-100 Futures
source.source_markets: NQ original series; MNQ author rebuild

mandatory_same_session_close: Exit at stop, target, or at 13:55 bar close / 14:00 open, whichever comes first.
max_entry_rule_origin: Selected research specification; one initial entry, no same-day re-entry. This cap is not an observed frequency.
observed_trade_frequency: NOT REPORTED for this exact selected specification

source_rules.indicator: Frozen 30-minute range, 0.85% filter, first 5-minute close above high, next-bar entry, 1:1 bracket, 14:00 flat.
source_rules.buy: After 10:00, first five-minute bar closing above the 09:30–10:00 high; enter long at next bar open. Skip if range/10:00 price >0.85%, FOMC decision days and exchange holidays.
source_rules.exit: Exit at stop, target, or at 13:55 bar close / 14:00 open, whichever comes first.
source_rules.take_profit: Entry plus (entry minus opening-range low), 1:1 reward/risk.
source_rules.cost_treatment: Rebuild assumes $2 round trip, with entry/stop slippage treatment documented separately; independent live fill validation is incomplete.

source_reported_performance: Author-reported MNQ rebuild: 754 trades, $17.83 net per trade, 57% win; original NQ 2010–2019 interval was −$2.29/trade, 2020–2026 +$129.20/trade; no untouched OOS.
source_sample: NQ study 2010–July 2026; executable MNQ rebuild 2020–July 2026. All intervals used in selection are in-sample.
known_risks: Regime break around 2020, multiple testing, no independent OOS, stop fill slippage.
data_requirements: Dated MNQ one-minute OHLCV, 5-minute aggregation, exchange calendar, FOMC calendar, contract roll metadata, and fill-cost schedule.
proposed_adaptations_not_source_validate: Freeze exclusion list before test and use prior-day volume to select active contract; audit same-bar stop/target ordering; forward-test untouched dates.

research_score.meaning: Research priority judgment; not probability of profitability

evidence_status: Author reconstruction after stated fees; no untouched OOS
